title: A producer browses packs and uses a sound from one they did not have

steps.caption: Open the sample slot of the drum machine's "BD" pad
Choose Browse packs: covers, with the project's packs marked
Narrow the packs to those with FX
Open Transitions & FX: it joins the project when you insert a sound
Choose FX, then Impact: only that pack's impacts are listed
Select an impact and press Insert: the "BD" slot names it
Open the slot again: Transitions & FX is listed with the project's packs
Reload: the BD pad holds the impact, and Transitions & FX is listed
